messages.subject: New release 1.1.13
parts:
Thanks to a bug found the other day, I'm releasing rApache 1.1.13.

The major change is that all rApache R functions (setContentType, etc)
plus the CGI vars are placed in an environment named 'rapache'
directly onto the search path right before the base environment. Prior
to this rApache would insert the environment into the lexical scoping
chain of user code.

Please test.

Jeff
--
http://biostat.mc.vanderbilt.edu/JeffreyHorner
